provenance.note: A point ON the channel the dredge works in, as the pick's {coordinates, name} verbatim, a (lon, lat) pair, 'lat,lon' or a point layer. Geocode a place name first; the channel is fetched downstream of it and the levels every dredging action reads are stationed along the centerline that comes back with it [supplied on this invocation]
Depth the fairway is dredged TO, under the reference water surface the run opens at - the design draught plus its overdepth [supplied on this invocation]

Depth at which a node is dredged: the bed is worked wherever it sits shallower than this under the reference surface. Equal to design_depth_m keeps the channel exactly at grade; SMALLER than it lets the channel shoal before the dredger returns, and a trigger DEEPER than the grade would mark a node for a cut that is above its own bed [supplied on this invocation]
When the first dredging pass begins, in seconds of the BED's own clock - the run's morphological time, DURATION x MORPHOLOGICAL FACTOR [supplied on this invocation]
When the campaign stops, on the same bed clock: no further pass begins after it, and a pass already cutting runs on until it reaches grade [supplied on this invocation]
Maintenance interval on the bed clock: how long after a pass starts the next one begins, if the channel has shoaled past trigger_depth_m again [supplied on this invocation]

How fast the dredger lowers the bed, as metres of bed per second of SOLVER time at a working node - the plant's capacity, not a physical rate. A pass reports its volume only once it has reached grade, so this and the cut it has to make are what decide whether the run sees a completed pass at all [supplied on this invocation]
How fast the spoil is laid into the dump area, as metres of bed per second of solver time at a receiving node; a pass is not finished until its spoil is placed [supplied on this invocation]

Target element edge or cell length the domain is resolved at. The granularity is the USER's lever: no sizing rung derives an edge from a channel nobody surveyed, so the number the run meshes at is either yours or this labeled default [supplied on this invocation]
Least volume worth moving around a node before it is dredged at all; 0 works every node past the trigger [declared scenario default]
Solve sizing class - how many cores the solve is partitioned across. An engine that runs on one core says so on the card [declared constant default]

Vertical datum this run counts every elevation from - the bed under it and the level over it. A source published on another frame reaches this one through a measured offset, and a pair nobody publishes an offset between refuses by name [declared constant default]
not supplied; a surface is read at the most recent cycle its own source has published, and no series source is asked at all - a record is a reading at a time, and this run stated none

answer.dredge_report: the volumes are the engine's own report lines, summed over the passes that finished inside the run's clock
answer.mesh_resolution_note: Target element edge or cell length the domain is resolved at. The granularity is the USER's lever: no sizing rung derives an edge from a channel nobody surveyed, so the number the run meshes at is either yours or this labeled default [supplied on this invocation]
